data.title: fix(k4run): drop the job's ChronoAuditor so audited services don't loop on AuditorSvc
data.author: jbeirer
data.body:
The 2026-10-18 nightly's reco jobs for ALLEGRO_o1_v04, ALLEGRO_o2_v01 and IDEA_o1_v04 failed at initialisation with `Initialization loop detected when creating service "AuditorSvc"`.

Their FCC-config steering adds a `ChronoAuditor`. With our `AuditServices = True`, that auditor creates `ChronoStatSvc`, and the service's audited initialise asks for the `AuditorSvc` that is still initialising.

The k4bench options file now removes `ChronoAuditor`. Nothing k4Bench measures is lost, since nothing reads its output, and service initialisation is still audited.


<!-- pr-agent-generated -->
### **PR Type**
Bug fix


___

### **Description**

config.get("auth.admin_cern_role") raised when the key was absent
(whenever METADATA_BROWSER_ADMIN_CERN_ROLE isn't set), crashing any

data.title: Make role badge the account dropdown trigger (sign in/out, user area)
data.author: kjvbrt
data.body:
Replaces the separate AuthSection button with a dropdown on the role
badge itself (sign in/out + a new bare-bones User Area page at
/account). Always shown, even when auth is disabled.

data.title: Remove Kaniko caching from backend builds
data.author: kjvbrt
data.body:
Kaniko's cache was silently reusing a stale final image manifest
(visible as "Returning cached image manifest" in build traces even
when source files changed), so staging kept running old backend
code under new tags. Confirmed by grepping the live pod's source.

data.title: Show a role badge in the header
data.author: kjvbrt
data.body:
Shows whether the current user is recognized and, if so, their
resolved role (viewer/editor/admin) -- a small pill in the header,
always rightmost.

data.title: Add viewer/editor/admin role-based access control
data.author: kjvbrt
data.body:
Replaces the all-or-nothing authenticated/not-authenticated gate with
three real tiers: viewer (default, read-only), editor (grantable
in-app by an admin), and admin (CERN role/e-group only, never stored
in the app's own DB). Adds admin-only user management endpoints and
a matching UI modal.

data.title: Add local dev setup (Podman Postgres, native backend/frontend)
data.author: kjvbrt
data.body:
Adds local-dev/ with a README and backend env template for running
Postgres in a Podman container while backend/frontend run natively
for hot-reload. Tested end-to-end.

data.title: Frontend UI polish: scroll listener, page titles, About modal
data.author: kjvbrt
data.body:
Defers the scroll-to-top listener (Firefox warning fix), prefixes
page titles with "DaMI | ", renames Contact modal to About (version
+ copyright moved there, footer removed), hides Edit button from
unauthenticated users, and fixes copyright text color.

data.title: Fix frontend version detection, rename to DAMI_VERSION
data.author: kjvbrt
data.body:
The docker-builder/tools image used by build-frontend has no git
binary, so `git describe` was silently producing an empty string and
the version always showed as "dev". Use GitLab's predefined
CI_COMMIT_TAG / CI_COMMIT_SHORT_SHA instead, and rename the variable
to DAMI_VERSION.

data.title: Show running version in the Contact modal
data.author: kjvbrt
data.body:
Bakes `git describe --tags --always` into the frontend image at
build time and shows it in the Contact modal, next to the existing
mailing-list/forum/repo links -- the exact tag on prod, "tag-N-gSHA"
on staging.

data.title: Fix staging database connectivity (TLS mode + main table)
data.author: kjvbrt
data.body:
Switches the staging DBOD connection to sslmode=require (it rejects
plaintext, and "prefer" was silently falling back to it) and sets
METADATA_BROWSER_MAIN_TABLE=datasets to match prod's schema. Confirmed
working end-to-end against the live fcc-dami-test instance.

data.author: jburzy
data.body:
`makeInitialCovariance` sets the initial q/p error to `InitialTrackError_RelP / p`, which is purely relative. For high pT seeds this is very small in absolute terms (0.005 e/GeV at 50 GeV with the default of 0.25), while the curvature estimate from three closely spaced hits can be much worse, especially in forward regions. Raising `InitialTrackError_RelP` frees the high pT seeds but also lets soft seeds drift, so fake tracks migrate to high pT.

data.title: Fix the orientation of the hit covariance in `prepareTrackerHits`
data.author: jburzy
data.body:
The hit position is converted into the local frame of the ACTS surface, but `du`/`dv` were assigned directly to loc0/loc1. They are defined along the hit's own u/v axes, which do not always match the surface's local x/y. In the MAIA IT/OT endcaps the two are swapped, so the precise direction got the large uncertainty and the coarse direction got the small one. Good endcap hits then failed the CKF chi2 cut, which led to holes and truncated or lost forward tracks.

The new `hitLocalCovariance` rotates diag(du², dv²) from the hit's u/v axes into the surface frame (`Surface::referenceFrame`). The 4D measurement uses the full rotated 2x2 block. Barrel modules are unchanged, since there u/v already match the local axes.

data.author: trholmes
data.body:
This is a proposed long-term fix for the problem described in this ticket (and several tickets):
https://github.com/key4hep/k4geo/issues/538

In many scenarios where the step-size was the same order as sensor thicknesses, we'd see short steps that end with an exit of the volume but don't deposit enough energy to make it past the 1 keV (or occasionally even the 0 energy) filter. The step would then be removed by the filter and the hit wouldn't close, continuing until it reached another sensor.
